(() => { window.__p = window.jupyterapp.shell.currentWidget; window.__nb = () => window.__p.content; window.__run = (i) => { const nb = window.__nb(); nb.activeCellIndex = i; return window.jupyterapp.commands.execute('notebook:run-cell'); }; window.__out = (i) => { const c = window.__nb().widgets[i]; const o = c && c.node.querySelector('.jp-OutputArea'); return o ? o.textContent : ''; }; window.__last = {}; window.__tries = {}; window.__seen = {}; window.__retry = (i, src, every) => { const cur = window.__out(i); if (new RegExp(src).test(cur)) return true; const now = Date.now(); if (!window.__last[i] || now - window.__last[i] > every) { if (cur) (window.__seen[i] = window.__seen[i] || []).push(cur.slice(0, 240)); window.__last[i] = now; window.__tries[i] = (window.__tries[i] || 0) + 1; window.__run(i); } return false; }; window.__fig = () => document.querySelector('.jp-OutputArea .sh'); window.__f = () => { const sh = window.__fig(); return sh ? {state: sh.dataset.state, chapter: sh.dataset.chapter, lang: sh.dataset.lang, readout: (sh.querySelector('[data-readout]') || {}).textContent} : null; }; return 'helpers'; })()

(() => { const f = window.__f(); if (!f || f.state !== '8' || f.lang !== 'en') throw new Error('kernel -> figure failed: ' + JSON.stringify(f)); return JSON.stringify({after_cell_2_python_wrote_state_8_en: f}); })()
window.__run(3).then(() => 'cell 3: lang ja, goto_chapter(open), t = 1 (kernel -> figure)')
(() => { const f = window.__f(); if (!f || f.state !== '4' || f.lang !== 'ja') throw new Error('kernel -> figure failed: ' + JSON.stringify(f)); return JSON.stringify({after_cell_3: f}); })()

(() => { const o = window.__out(4); if (!new RegExp("state 5 \u00b7 t \\d+ \u00b7 lang ja").test(o)) throw new Error('cell 4 does not show the expected output: ' + o.slice(-300)); return JSON.stringify({figure_to_kernel_values_cell_4: true, tries: window.__tries[4] || 0, seen_before: window.__seen[4] || [], out: o.slice(-300)}); })()

(() => { const o = window.__out(5); if (!new RegExp("'state': 4,[\\s\\S]*'equal': True").test(o)) throw new Error('cell 5 does not show the expected output: ' + o.slice(-300)); return JSON.stringify({recount_state4_equal: true, tries: window.__tries[5] || 0, seen_before: window.__seen[5] || [], out: o.slice(-300)}); })()

(() => { const o = window.__out(6); if (!new RegExp("'state': 18,[\\s\\S]*'equal': True").test(o)) throw new Error('cell 6 does not show the expected output: ' + o.slice(-300)); if (window.__fig().dataset.state !== '18') throw new Error('the figure did not follow goto_chapter(sae): ' + window.__fig().dataset.state); return JSON.stringify({sae_recount_state18_equal: true, tries: window.__tries[6] || 0, seen_before: window.__seen[6] || [], out: o.slice(-300)}); })()
JSON.stringify({tries_until_equal_by_cell: window.__tries, note: 'runs of each cell until its own output matched (1 = the first run)'})
